name: LoopNav
summary: 利用 Minecraft 闭环导航和重访场景检验世界模型空间记忆。
summaryEn: Tests spatial memory in world models using Minecraft navigation loops and scene revisits.
scale: Publisher reports 250 navigation hours; current fixed benchmark has 720 trajectories
scaleZh: 发布方报告 250 小时导航；当前固定评测为 720 条轨迹
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: Consult publisher terms; data license not independently verified
licenseZh: 请核对发布方条款；数据许可尚未独立核实
wmNote: 2025 年原始论文与后续发布版本区分；重访一致性不等于物理真实性。
wmNoteEn: Distinguish the 2025 original paper from subsequent release versions; revisit consistency does not establish physical realism.

evidence.locator: Dataset and benchmark; TURN / ABA / ABCA tasks
evidence.statement: Action-annotated navigation loops return to previously seen locations via rotations, retraced paths and alternate paths. Scene Graph Consistency Score evaluates persistence of the generated scene across revisits.

yearBasis.description: Original preprint in May 2025; current repository also describes a 2026 benchmark update.
